definitions.text: A South African bulbous plant of the Iris family, remarkable for the brilliancy of its flowers.
A genus of parasitic Acarina, which includes various species of ticks. See Tick, the insect.
A tick of the genus Ixodes, or the family Ixodidæ.
A Mexican name for a variety of Agave rigida, which furnishes a strong coarse fiber; also, the fiber itself, which is called also pita, and Tampico fiber. [Written also istle.]
The fine, soft fiber of the bromeliaceous plant Bromelia sylvestris.
